title: 方舟用量 · wtpm / RPM
description: 同一看板展示各模型 Token 与请求量的分钟趋势，共用账号、模型和时间筛选。1 wtpm = 10,000 Token/分钟，RPM 为请求/分钟；仅覆盖已导入数据。

list.name: account
list.label: 账号
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT account_id AS __text, account_id AS __value FROM public.ark_usage_records ORDER BY 1;
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT account_id AS __text, account_id AS __value FROM public.ark_usage_records ORDER BY 1;

list.name: model
list.label: 模型
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT model_name AS __text, model_name AS __value
FROM public.ark_usage_records WHERE account_id IN (${account:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1;
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT model_name AS __text, model_name AS __value
FROM public.ark_usage_records WHERE account_id IN (${account:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: 各模型总 wtpm · 随时间变化
panels.description: 1 wtpm = 10,000 Token/分钟。输入与输出相加，缓存已包含在输入中。固定一分钟桶，缺少记录补 0；仅覆盖已导入的部分模型。

panels.title: 各模型 RPM · 随时间变化
panels.description: 每分钟请求数，按账号、模型和请求 ID 去重，以最早用量记录时间分桶；缺失分钟补 0。仅覆盖已导出请求。
